Maya R.: Heads-up team: new hire Lina Gomez (international transfer) arrives Tue. Passport valid but visa stamp ends in 40 days. Background check returned with an alias match flag (different last name). Need to confirm I-9 approach and whether we can do remote verification via notary or must be in-person kiosk.

Kenji T.: For I-9, foreign passport + work authorization stamp usually counts as List A if unexpired. Remote notarization exception is only allowed in certain states; do we have approval for her location?

onboard-bot: Policy note: Remote I-9 temporaries require HR approval + candidate state on approved list. See policy: https://redwood.internal/hr/i9-remote

Nora P.: She's in NJ. NJ is on the approved remote-notary list. But we still need to intake original docs to our system within 3 days. Notarized inspection is ok for onboarding.

Maya R.: Great. Background alias flag 91234	2: vendor requested additional name history. I asked Lina for previous last name; she replied via DM confirming maiden name.

Kenji T.: Good. Once vendor confirms, we can proceed. For the notary flow: we use "NotaryNow" vendor and schedule a 1-hr window. Candidate must present originals to notary and send a photo of the passport data page to the portal.

Maya R.: Also, laptop delivery: courier can't access building loading dock before 9:30. Lina arrives by train around 8:45. Options: locker or have Facilities meet and store equipment.

Facilities: We can do a locker for same-day pickup. Locker codes are single-use. Need employee phone and expected pickup window.

Maya R.: I'll ask Lina for phone and arrival ETA. Also, can we pre-create a temporary badge for the notary pickup so the notary can access the lobby?

Facilities: Notary will be escorted by front desk. If we have the candidate's name and company voucher code, that's sufficient.

Maya R.: Payroll question: will benefits trigger if paperwork completed after transfer? She is eligible on the first of next month but needs W-4 and direct deposit set. If not completed, benefits enrollments can be delayed.

Payroll Team: Confirmed. For transfers the effective date is next month 1st. W-4 + direct deposit forms by EOD Fri will ensure benefits set on time. Not a blocker for day-1 orientation.

Maya R.: Noted. Tentative Day-1 schedule: 9:30 meet-notary (if remote), 10:30 HR intro (virtual), 11:00 team lunch meetup, 14:00 access/setup with IT (locker pickup if needed). If notary delayed, we'll shift the HR intro to 11:30.

Kenji T.: Add note: if candidate's visa stamp expires within 60 days, run secondary verification with immigration team. Lina's at 40 days, so flagging immigration for clearance.

Maya R.: I'll open a ticket.

onboard-bot: Background check 047660 status: pending vendor docs.

Maya R.: Update: Lina sent prior last-name and photo. Vendor cleared alias at 2355004490.

Nora P.: Notary scheduled for Tue 9:15-10:15. Notary vendor emailed instructions; candidate must bring passport + I-94.

Maya R.: Locker reserved #7 with single-use PIN. Courier will place laptop at 2355004518. Facilities will email access instructions to candidate phone.

Facilities: Locker PIN sent to candidate via SMS at 2355004519. Escort arranged if needed.

Payroll Team: Reminder to new hire: complete W-4 + direct deposit by Friday to avoid benefit delay. Payroll will send secure link upon hire confirmation.

Maya R.: Everything green. Final note to candidate message that I'll send: 
"Bring original passport and I-94; notary will inspect. If passport renewal is in progress, bring current passport. Bring any prior last names to speed background check. Locker code will be texted for laptop pickup."

Kenji T.: Perfect. Closing loop, thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
